wire.t: Thursday night: Commanders 24, Giants 21. Isaiah Likely caught 9 balls for 127 yards and a 66-yard touchdown for 28.70 in superdog91's lineup, Cam Skattebo scored twice for 27.20 for Buccaneer51, and Stefon Diggs caught the 32-yard winner for 20.30 for Bill_Buttlicker. Jayden Daniels scored 20.76 on Marco_Polo's bench behind Brock Purdy.

The Rams put Puka Nacua on injured reserve Thursday after saying Wednesday they wouldn't. He sits out at least four games: at Arizona, Green Bay, Kansas City and at San Francisco. superdog91 owns Nacua (175.60 points); ChuckJ10 owns Davante Adams, also on Rams IR.

Fernando Mendoza makes his first NFL start Sunday against Seattle after the Raiders traded Kirk Cousins. superdog91 rosters Mendoza (2.22 points so far) as a backup to Josh Allen. TotesMagoat (Brock Bowers) and MakeItRains (Ashton Jeanty) get a rookie quarterback.

Kirk Cousins took his first full practice back with the Vikings Thursday and is expected to start Sunday at Green Bay. RedDevil904 owns Cousins (177.30 points) but has Trevor Lawrence in the Week 10 lineup. TotesMagoat owns Justin Jefferson; Bill_Buttlicker owns Jordan Addison.

Patriots-Lions in Munich: Rhamondre Stevenson (Marco_Polo) is expected to miss with a knee injury and TreVeyon Henderson (RobMeyers) is out. Corey Kiner, in BeatULikeABoss's lineup, could lead the backfield. Jets WR Garrett Wilson (TotesMagoat) is questionable coming out of concussion protocol.

Jacoby Brissett says he's in a 'crash course' for Monday night against the 0-8 Chargers as the Ravens' fourth starting quarterback. Bill_Buttlicker owns Brissett (111.16 points) behind Patrick Mahomes.

First league trade since Sept. 17: TotesMagoat sent Kaleb Johnson and his 2029 3rd to BeatULikeABoss for BeatULikeABoss's 2029 2nd. BeatULikeABoss also got his own 2029 5th back. Johnson has 23.20 points this season, all of them on Lemon Squeezy's bench, and is already in Young Love Hunters' Week 10 lineup.
Malik Willis went to IR with a groin injury and Kyle McCord is in line for his first NFL start Sunday at Indianapolis. BeatULikeABoss owns Willis and claimed McCord for $145 of FAAB on Tuesday night.

stories.title: Isaiah Likely drops 28.70 on Thursday and 50 Shades of Rae is already up 28.70 to 12.20
stories.dek: Cam Skattebo gives I Believe in Love a 27.20‑0 head start, and Prepetente is the GOAT! has two empty RB slots heading into Sunday.
body: Commanders 24, Giants 21, and the fantasy damage is already on the board. Isaiah Likely caught 9 passes for 127 yards and a 66-yard touchdown from J.J. McCarthy for 28.70, the best score of the night. superdog91 had him at tight end, so 50 Shades of Rae (7-2) leads Young Love Hunters 28.70 to 12.20 before Sunday even starts. BeatULikeABoss got 12.20 from Antonio Williams and left the Giants defense (5.00) on the bench. That's 1-8 math. The line was 99% before kickoff and Thursday did nothing to change it.

Cam Skattebo ran for two touchdowns and 27.20 points, so I Believe in Love leads Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 27.20 to 0.00. Buccaneer51 needs all of it. ChuckJ10 is still a 95% favorite with Kenneth Walker III, CeeDee Lamb and Trey McBride going Sunday. Over in my game, Stefon Diggs caught the 32-yard winner with 57 seconds left for 20.30, so Picken Weiners leads Hanging with Hernandez 20.30 to 0.00. G8rDuc had McCarthy (18.12) on the bench, and before you yell: Bryce Young has 150.58 points this season and McCarthy has 37.98. That's the right call that looked wrong for one night.

Same story on Prepetente is the GOAT!. Jayden Daniels threw two picks, still scored 20.76 on Marco_Polo's bench, and Brock Purdy (175.30 points) is the starter. Fine. The real problem is that as of Friday morning both of Marco_Polo's running back slots are empty. Rhamondre Stevenson is expected to miss Munich with a knee injury, J.K. Dobbins is on a Broncos bye, Sean Tucker is on a Buccaneers bye and Brian Robinson Jr. is on IR. Nobody's dumb here, the roster is just out of running backs. FAAB is open, Marco_Polo. Mean Machine is an 87% favorite and doesn't need the help.

Lemon Squeezy got 7.40 from Malik Nabers on Thursday, which is the only thing TotesMagoat has done wrong this month. The Week 10 payout is the Highest-Scoring Receiver, and Likely leads it at 28.70 over Diggs (20.30). Somebody on Sunday has to beat a tight end, which is a sentence I never thought this league would need.

stories.title: TotesMagoat sells Kaleb Johnson the week Josh Jacobs goes under the knife
stories.dek: Lemon Squeezy (8‑1) flips a bench back and a 2029 3rd for Young Love Hunters' 2029 2nd. It's the first league trade in almost two months.
body: The trade drought is over. TotesMagoat sent Kaleb Johnson and Lemon Squeezy's 2029 3rd to BeatULikeABoss for Young Love Hunters' 2029 2nd, and BeatULikeABoss got his own 2029 5th back in the deal. It's the first trade in this league since Sept. 17. Johnson is 23 and scored 23.20 points in nine weeks for Lemon Squeezy, every one of them on the bench, 12.80 of them in Week 9.

Here's why it's interesting: Josh Jacobs is getting surgery on a fractured ring finger, and the reports range from out indefinitely to a maximum of three weeks. Johnson ran 14 times for 68 yards and a touchdown against the Patriots once Jacobs went down. MarShawn Lloyd (Bill_Buttlicker, yes, me) is reported good to go for Sunday against the Vikings, so it's not a clean lead job. BeatULikeABoss didn't wait to find out. Johnson is already in Young Love Hunters' Week 10 lineup against 50 Shades of Rae, who is still a 99% favorite.

The dynasty math: TotesMagoat now owns 2029 2nds from himself and BeatULikeABoss, still has six firsts across the next three drafts, and the team that's 1-8 is the one most likely to make that 2nd an early one. He sold a guy who never cracked his lineup for a better pick in a year when Young Love Hunters could still be bad. BeatULikeABoss gets a 23-year-old back with a possible starting role for a few weeks and still holds eight 2027 picks in the first three rounds. Rich get richer, rebuild gets a running back. Nobody got robbed, which is honestly a disappointment for this website.

TotesMagoat wasn't done. He picked up David Njoku, who's on IR with a fibula injury but was designated to return on Nov. 4, and the Chargers defense. And I claimed Ashton Dulin and dropped Elijah Mitchell, because the Colts just traded Josh Downs and somebody has to catch passes in Indianapolis.

stories.title: The Rams put Puka Nacua on IR, and 50 Shades of Rae's rookie backup is now a starter
stories.dek: superdog91 is 7‑2, loses Nacua for at least four games, and somehow gains Fernando Mendoza.
body: The Rams changed course Thursday and put Puka Nacua on injured reserve so they could sign Brennan Presley. He sits out at least four games: at Arizona this week, then Green Bay, Kansas City and at San Francisco, with the Week 11 bye in there too. That's 175.60 points off superdog91's roster, second among his receivers behind Christian Watson (181.90). Davante Adams, ChuckJ10's receiver, is also on Rams IR with a hamstring.

The weird part: superdog91 also owns Fernando Mendoza, the first pick in the 2026 NFL Draft, who starts Sunday against Seattle's league-best pass defense after the Raiders traded Kirk Cousins. Mendoza has 2.22 fantasy points this season and is Josh Allen's backup, so nothing changes this week. In dynasty, a 50 Shades of Rae roster with four firsts just got a starting rookie quarterback for free. The rich get richer, part 400.

Josh Jacobs had surgery on a fractured finger, with reports ranging from out indefinitely to a maximum of three weeks. BertDirty is 4-5 with the fourth-most points per game (136.94) and Mean Machine is still an 87% favorite over Prepetente is the GOAT!. Kaleb Johnson, traded Wednesday to BeatULikeABoss, and MarShawn Lloyd (Bill_Buttlicker) are the Packers backs to watch Sunday against the Vikings.

Elsewhere: Rhamondre Stevenson (Marco_Polo) is expected to miss Sunday in Munich and TreVeyon Henderson (RobMeyers) is out. Garrett Wilson (TotesMagoat) is questionable coming out of concussion protocol. Kyle McCord starts for Miami, Carson Beck starts for Arizona from RobMeyers' taxi squad, and Jacoby Brissett starts Monday night for the Ravens.

stories.title: The NFL trade deadline just rewrote three quarterback rooms in this league
stories.dek: Jacoby Brissett is a Raven, Kirk Cousins is a Viking again, Fernando Mendoza is a starter and Kyle McCord cost $145.
body: The Ravens traded for Jacoby Brissett with Lamar Jackson on IR, and Brissett is expected to start Monday night against the Chargers. Bill_Buttlicker owns him as the backup to Patrick Mahomes, who is day-to-day with an elbow strain and expected to play at Atlanta. So the commissioner's QB2 is now an actual NFL starter. I'd like to say that was the plan. It was not the plan. RedDevil904 owns Jackson (84.08 points) and gets nothing out of this except a reason to start Kirk Cousins.

Speaking of Cousins: the Vikings sent the Raiders a 2027 third for him at the deadline, and he's likely to start soon if not right away. RedDevil904 has him at 177.30 points this season, and Trevor Have I Ever is 5-4 with no 2027 first, second or third. Cousins is 38. All-In doesn't mean what it used to. ChuckJ10 owns Kyler Murray, who is week-to-week with a hamstring strain, so the Vikings job he'd come back to now has Cousins in it.

In Miami, Malik Willis went to IR and Kyle McCord will start for at least the next four weeks, beginning Sunday at Indianapolis. BeatULikeABoss owns Willis and paid $145 of FAAB Tuesday night for McCord. In Las Vegas, the Cousins trade made Fernando Mendoza (superdog91) the starter. Also moved at the deadline: Keenan Allen (TotesMagoat) to the 49ers and Josh Downs (G8rDuc) to the Chiefs. Week 10 lines haven't moved: Lemon Squeezy 93%, 50 Shades of Rae 99%, Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 95%, Mean Machine 87%, Trevor Have I Ever 74% and Picken Weiners 71%.

columns.title: TotesMagoat sold a guy he never played. That's how you stay 8‑1
columns.dek: Kaleb Johnson started zero games for Lemon Squeezy. Now he's a 2029 2nd.
body: Kaleb Johnson was on Lemon Squeezy's roster for nine weeks and started zero times. 23.20 points, all bench. Then Josh Jacobs breaks a finger, Johnson gets 14 carries and a touchdown, and TotesMagoat sells him the same week. That's not luck. That's knowing what you have.

BeatULikeABoss, I don't hate it. You're 1-8, he's 23, and you put him in the lineup right away. But you paid with your own 2029 2nd, and your team has been bad enough this year that somebody's going to circle that pick. Win some games so it's a late one. That's the whole job now.

columns.title: Holden McGroin's Four Rules After Thursday Night Football
columns.dek: One game is a sample size. I've built a whole system on it.
body: 1. Always start the quarterback who scored on Thursday. Jayden Daniels scored 20.76 on Marco_Polo's bench. Brock Purdy has scored 0.00 in Week 10. That's a 20.76-point lead for Daniels, and the math doesn't care that Purdy has 175.30 points this season and hasn't played yet.

2. Never start a quarterback whose team is about to win. G8rDuc benched J.J. McCarthy and the Giants lost 24-21 anyway. If McCarthy had been in the lineup the Giants would've known they had to try harder. That's called accountability.

3. Tight ends are wide receivers now. Isaiah Likely (28.70) is leading the Week 10 Highest-Scoring Receiver payout. Going forward I'm starting tight ends at quarterback. My first pick is Travis Kelce, who is 37 and has been throwing in the backyard for years, probably.
4. Empty roster spots are just players who haven't been named yet. Marco_Polo has two of them at running back this week. Think of the upside. Zero carries means zero fumbles. Every week. Undefeated.

columns.title: 55% of Kaleb Johnson's season came in one week, so my model says he's 55% sold
columns.dek: 23.20 points, nine weeks, zero starts, one trade.
body: Kaleb Johnson scored 12.80 of his 23.20 points in Week 9. That's 55.2% of his season in 11.1% of the weeks, which my 'Concentration Coefficient' rates as 5.0, the highest number I've ever made up. He also scored -0.20 in Week 6, which means at one point he owed Lemon Squeezy points.

TotesMagoat now owns two 2029 2nds and six firsts across the next three drafts. Young Love Hunters is 1-8 with 633.52 points, or 70.39 per game, which my model converts to a 'Pick Pedigree Score' of 1-8. That's just the record again. I'm told the pick is going to be good, and so is my spreadsheet.

top.t: The Trade That Built an Empire
top.take: In January 2020, superdog91 sent the picks that became Justin Jefferson and Justin Herbert to TotesMagoat for Devin Singletary and a third. Jefferson and Herbert have scored 3,708.3 points since. TotesMagoat has four titles. superdog91 has three, which is impressive given he handed his rival the keys.

Bill_Buttlicker got Patrick Mahomes and the pick that became Chuba Hubbard. G8rDuc got Drew Brees, who retired after the season, and the Michael Carter pick. The scoreboard says 2,853.1 to 529.9. G8rDuc is 22-80 all time, and this is part of why.

ChuckJ10 bought Michael Thomas in November 2020 and paid with Christian Kirk plus his 2021 and 2022 firsts. Thomas gave him 220.1 points. The 2022 first became Chris Olave. ChuckJ10 has never made a final, and trades like this are a big reason why.

superdog91 got Kenny Gainwell and the picks that became George Pickens (#16) and Kyren Williams, a fourth-rounder at #40, all for Devin Singletary. Kyren alone has 970.9 points. RedDevil904 still has never made the playoffs.

RedDevil904 sent five picks to Bill_Buttlicker for Christian McCaffrey. Those picks became Javonte Williams, Elijah Moore, Kenneth Walker III, Malik Willis and Roschon Johnson. CMC gave RedDevil904 1,482.6 points. The picks have given 2,855.7.

TotesMagoat got Amon-Ra St. Brown from Besch42 for Mecole Hardman Jr. and Quintez Cephus. St. Brown has 1,598.9 points since. Four months later, Besch42 lost the 2021 final to TotesMagoat. He'd handed him the WR1 himself.

Self-roast time. Bill_Buttlicker traded the picks that became DeVonta Smith (#11) and Kenny Gainwell to RedDevil904 for Miles Sanders. Sanders: 524.5. Smith and Gainwell: 1,782.6. The man who runs this website did that.
